description: Battery Electric Car example, rebuilt on the 2021 Cupra Born 58 kWh (CON-03): topology, four cases (City Cycle on the default profile DR-06, WLTC class 3b DR-25, the same with the heating/air-con load at 2.5 kW DR-26, and a live 10x City Cycle) and its values. From FASTSim's 2021_Cupra_Born.csv: mass 1,927 kg, Cd 0.27, frontal area 2.31 m2, wheel radius 0.3488 m, wheel inertia 0.815 kg m2, rolling resistance 0.011, 61 % of the weight on the driven axle (30.5 % per driven wheel, 19.5 % per other wheel), battery 62 kWh with a 4 % floor (58 kWh usable), auxiliary load 0.25 kW, transmission efficiency 98 % (final drive 98 %, differential 100 %), recuperation weight 98 % (maxRegen), motor 150 kW. Not from FASTSim: motor maps (DR-22 to DR-24) and final drive 12.8. Every other value is a component default (DR-04 to DR-17).

description: P2 Hybrid Car example, rebuilt as a Hyundai Ioniq Hybrid Blue class car (CON-02): topology plus a 0.5 kW '12 V Loads' consumer, the Hybrid Control Unit script (a charge-sustaining strategy with a copy of the engine curve DR-27 and the motor's 170 N m / 32 kW), four cases (EPA UDDS DR-34, EPA HWFET DR-35, the Mixed Cycle DR-03 and its live copy) with charge-balanced start SOCs of 56.7 / 58.9 / 51.79 %. From the EPA 2022 Test Car List (Ioniq, test MHYX10066415): test mass 1,474 kg (ETW 3,250 lb); road load A 15.431 lbf, B 0.32897 lbf/mph, C 0.014602 lbf/mph2 fitted over UDDS and HWFET as rolling resistance 0.0064 and Cd x A 0.70 m2 (Cd 0.318 with the default 2.2 m2); N/V 32.6 1/min per mph gives the final drive 3.38 with the default 6th gear (0.7) and a 0.31 m wheel. From FASTSim: 0.5 kW auxiliary load and 95 % transmission efficiency (final drive 98 %, differential 100 %, gearbox default 97 %) as in its HEV files, wheel inertia 0.815 kg m2 (its default). Background knowledge (unverified): engine 77 kW / 147 N m, motor 32 kW / 170 N m, battery 1.56 kWh at 240 V, 195/65 R15 tyres (0.31 m). Synthetic: engine, motor and battery maps (DR-27 to DR-33), battery resistance 0.1 ohm, the control strategy. Every other value is a component default (DR-04 to DR-17).
